blocks.alt: A dog and a tortoise at the finish line
blocks.caption: The tortoise wins the race!

blocks.md:
Once upon a time, a tortoise called out a dog for a race.

'I can run faster than you,' said the tortoise.

'You? You must be joking! Even in my sleep, you cannot run faster than me,' laughed the dog.

The tortoise planned to prepare large chunks of delicious meat with fat bones. He deliberately dropped the pieces of meat along the paths of the race thinking that the dog will smell out the pieces of meat and get attracted to them.

On the day of their race, the other animals gathered to watch the most interesting race. As soon as the race was started, the dog flew past the tortoise with high speed while the tortoise picked his steps as slowly and clumsily as he could do.

Soon, the dog saw a chunk of meat on the way. He stopped and said to himself, 'I will take a bite of this tasty meat before that slowcoach comes here.'

As soon as he finished eating that meat, a few paces ahead he saw another piece on his path. So he slowed down and stopped to eat each piece. When the dog finally reached the finishing line, he met the tortoise there. He was surprised to see the tortoise before him and all the other animals praising the tortoise for winning the race.

quiz.q: Why did Dog stop during the race?
quiz.explain: Dog stopped to eat the delicious meat.
The tortoise won because the dog was distracted.
